name: ST NUCLEO-H563ZI (Nucleo-144)
description: 250 MHz Cortex-M33 (TrustZone) Nucleo-144 with Ethernet, USB-C, FDCAN, 2 MB flash and ST-LINK; a modern secure, connected alternative to the older H7 boards.
notes: Zio (Arduino Uno V3 superset) plus ST morpho headers; ST-LINK uses a micro-USB port and the user USB port is a separate connector (dual USB). 100 GPIO is an estimate of what reaches the connectors.
ST eStore list price jumped well above the original launch price; check current stock and price, as DigiKey showed long lead times.
KiCad footprint is the common Nucleo-144 morpho connector footprint (no dedicated symbol for this board).
